purpose: Teach: アトリエ/バグダッド/整形/雛/赤十字/ダンボール/グアム/スーパーマーケット

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、絵を描くアトリエ作りたいんだろ?
lines.en: Riku — you want to build a studio where you can paint, right?
lines.style: Light, testing opener. Leans in with genuine curiosity but keeps it casual. Quick rhythm, like she's probing to see what he'll admit.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、世界史でバグダッドの単元、覚えてるか?桜
lines.en: You remember that unit on Baghdad in world history, right Sakura?
lines.style: Deliberate redirect. Spoken with quiet control — he's changing the subject on purpose. Slight weight on the question mark, like he knows she notices he dodged.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のお父さん、整形外科の先生だろ?
lines.en: Riku — your dad's an orthopedic surgeon, isn't he?
lines.style: Pressing gently, undeterred. Rapid-fire curiosity. She's not letting him off the hook easily, but there's no edge to it — just persistent interest in what he's actually thinking.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、雛祭りの伝統知ってるか?桜
lines.en: You know about the traditions behind Hinamatsuri, right Sakura?
lines.style: Another dodge. Quieter this time, almost resigned — he knows she sees through it. Rhythmic, like he's buying time. The question is genuine but it's a shield.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、赤十字のボランティア、興味あるんだろ?
lines.en: Riku — you're interested in volunteering with the Red Cross, aren't you?
lines.style: Soft insistence. She's listing things now, not asking. Affectionate exasperation creeping in. Speaking like she's collecting pieces of him he won't hand over.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ダンボール工作得意だろ?桜
lines.en: You're pretty good at cardboard crafts, right Sakura?
lines.style: Deflection wearing thinner. His voice stays level but there's a brittleness underneath — like he's running out of questions to throw back. Acknowledging her competence as a soft counter.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家族でグアム行ったろ?
lines.en: Riku — didn't your family go to Guam?
lines.style: The rhythm breaks slightly. She's tired of the game now. More direct, less playful. Still warm but with an undertone of 'please just talk to me about what matters.'

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、スーパーマーケットでバイトしてんだろ?桜
lines.en: You work part-time at a supermarket, don't you Sakura?
lines.style: Final deflection. Exhausted but precise. He's so close to her, this question is almost intimate — the kind of thing a person only knows because they actually pay attention. Trailing off slightly, like surrender.
